req.title: Create new post
req.statement: The system shall insert a new post attributed to the logged-in user when POST /create receives a title and body, then redirect to /.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'Create new post' functionality by covering positive, negative, and boundary cases. This ensures that the system behaves correctly under normal conditions, handles errors gracefully, and respects boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_create_post_success
preconditions: User is logged in as Rahul
actions: POST /create with valid title and body
expected: New post is inserted in the database
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Create a new post
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'New Post', 'body': 'This is a new post.'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

# Verify the post was inserted
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import get_db
    db = get_db()
    post = db.execute('SELECT * FROM post WHERE title = ? AND body = ?', ('New Post', 'This is a new post.')).fetchone()
    assert post is not None

tests.name: test_create_post_missing_title
preconditions: User is logged in as Rahul
expected: Error message 'Title is required.' is flashed
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in as Rahul
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to create a post with missing title
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': '', 'body': 'This is a new post without a title.'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Title is required.' in r.data
